identity.description: Pass "unexpected" to keep only identities that break a no-unknown-errors policy: labels outside `namespace_prefix` (library tags such as `AI.Error`, bare `Error`) plus the 5xx and unexpected-error-envelope markers. Omit for all errors.

namespace_prefix.description: The prefix every deliberate, namespaced error tag starts with (default "@maple/"). Only used with identity="unexpected".

limit.description: Max error types to return (default 20, max 200)

fingerprint.description: The error FingerprintHash from find_errors or list_error_issues: a decimal UInt64 string, e.g. "11640295108927840024".

issue_id.description: An error issue id (UUID) from list_error_issues, instead of fingerprint.

end_time.description: End of the window, UTC (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or ISO 8601). Default: now; a future time is clamped to now.

include_timeseries.description: Include error count over time to see if the error is trending up or down

limit.description: Max sample traces to return (default 5, max 20)

workflow_state.description: Filter by workflow state (default: all non-archived)

severity.description: Filter by triage severity, or 'unset' for untriaged issues

kind.description: Filter by issue kind: error (fingerprint groups), alert (alert-rule incidents) or integration (third-party webhooks)

last_seen_after.description: Only issues with an occurrence after this time, the way to ask "what fired recently" without paging the whole backlog, UTC (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or ISO 8601)

exception_type.description: Only issues with this exact exception type or error label

search.description: Case-insensitive substring of the exception type, message, label or service name

compact.description: Default true: narrow rows (id, state, severity, service, exception, events, last seen, fingerprint). Pass false for priority, assignment, lease and notes

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` from a previous page, to read the next one

issue_id.description: Optional: narrow to incidents for this issue ID. If omitted, returns org-wide open incidents.

service.description: Only this service (exact `service.name`), matched on the entry span, or on every span when `span_name` is set

environment.description: Only this deployment environment (e.g. production, staging)

http_method.description: Only spans with this HTTP method

span_name.description: Case-insensitive substring of the span name. Switches the search to span level

attribute_key.description: Span attribute to filter on (e.g. user.id). Alone, requires the attribute to exist. With a value, a resource attribute (k8s.pod.name) also works

root_only.description: With `span_name`, still match entry spans only instead of every span

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (default 0). Use the `next` call a truncated result gives.

timestamp.description: Any timestamp from the trace (e.g. a search_traces Start). Narrows the scan to ±1h around it; required for traces older than 30 days, and faster for any trace older than 24h, UTC (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or ISO 8601)

errors_only.description: Render only error spans, their ancestors and the roots: the fastest way to read a large trace's failure without its healthy spans.

max_spans.description: Max spans to render in the tree; errors and roots are always kept (default 60, max 300)

trace_id.description: The trace ID the span belongs to

span_id.description: The span ID to inspect (from `inspect_trace` output)

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the span (e.g. from search_traces). Narrows the scan to ±1h and saves an AI span the lookup that resolves its trace's bounds, UTC (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or ISO 8601)

payload_chars.description: Max characters per captured message or payload (AI spans only) (default 2000, max 20000)

severity.description: Only logs at this severity level (matches every SDK spelling of it)

search.description: Substring of the log body, applied before clustering

sample_size.description: Recent logs sampled for clustering; more finds rarer templates, costs more (default 10000, max 50000)

source.description: 'traces' for request/span analysis (latency, errors, throughput); 'logs' for log volume; 'metrics' for a custom metric (needs metric_name and metric_type from list_metrics); 'product_events' for track() events, page views and server events (names from list_product_events).

kind.description: 'timeseries' for how a value changed over time; 'breakdown' for top-N or distribution. Pick the right one first rather than calling twice.

metric.description: Traces: count, avg_duration, p50_duration, p95_duration, p99_duration, error_rate (0-1 ratio), apdex (needs apdex_threshold_ms). Logs: count. Product events: count, sessions, persons, users, visitors. Metrics: avg, sum, min, max, count, rate, increase. For counters (sum metrics, Prometheus *_total gauges) use increase (total over the window) or rate (per second); both are per-series and reset-aware. sum adds raw samples. Default: count, or avg for metrics.

group_by.description: Traces: service, span_name, status_code, http_method, attribute, resource_attribute. Logs: service, severity. Metrics: service, attribute, resource_attribute. Product events: event_name, kind, source, host, page_path, service, group, attribute. 'attribute' and 'resource_attribute' need attribute_key (resource_attribute reads resource keys such as k8s.pod.name or deployment.environment). Timeseries also take 'none' (the default); breakdown defaults to service.

span_name.description: Filter by span name (traces only). Exact match first; when nothing matches exactly it is matched as a case-insensitive substring

environments.description: Only these deployment environments (traces, logs, metrics; explore_attributes source=services lists them)

apdex_threshold_ms.description: Apdex threshold in ms (traces only; needed for metric=apdex)

host.description: Only events fired on this site host (product_events only)

page_path.description: Only events fired on this page path (product_events only)

metric_type.description: Type of `metric_name`, as list_metrics reports it

attribute_key.description: Attribute to filter on, or to group by with group_by=attribute. Span (or log/metric label) and resource attributes both work; the scope is resolved automatically

attribute_value.description: Exact value for attribute_key. Also applies when grouping by the same key

attribute_scope.description: Where attribute_key lives: 'span' (span, log or metric-datapoint attributes) or 'resource' (deployment.environment, k8s.pod.name...). Resolved from the known keys when omitted

bucket_seconds.description: Bucket width in seconds (timeseries only; auto-computed when omitted)

limit.description: Max rows of a breakdown (default 10, max 100)

current_start.description: Start of the current period (default: 1 hour before current_end), UTC (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or ISO 8601)

current_end.description: End of the current period (default: now), UTC (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or ISO 8601)

previous_start.description: Start of the previous period (default: the current period's length before previous_end), UTC (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or ISO 8601)

previous_end.description: End of the previous period (default: current_start), UTC (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or ISO 8601)

around_time.description: Compare the 30 minutes before this time with the 30 minutes after it; overrides the four period bounds, UTC (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss or ISO 8601)

service.description: Scope the comparison to this service (exact `service.name`)

environment.description: Only this deployment environment (e.g. production, staging)

services.description: Only rules covering any of these services: scoped to them, scoped to every service, or raw_query rules whose SQL or name mentions them

signal_type.description: Only rules on this signal type
